description: Analyzes audience intelligence, streaming data, and career metrics for independent artists.

capabilities.name: calculate_viral_potential_score
capabilities.description: Estimate viral potential using a transparent heuristic rubric (tempo/BPM, genre, mood). Heuristic estimate only — not a prediction from historical streaming data.

capabilities.name: benchmark_release_velocity
capabilities.description: Project an expected release velocity curve (day 1/7/30) from the artist's Spotify follower baseline. Projection from follower count — does not yet read actual per-track streaming trajectories.

capabilities.name: detect_streaming_anomalies
capabilities.description: Scan streaming event logs for sudden spikes or drop-offs to detect potential botting or viral events.

capabilities.name: run_cohort_analysis
capabilities.description: Run cohort retention queries to track weekly user listening activity.
